definitionBean.title: Oxidation
definitionBean.definition: Gain of oxygen or loss (reduction) of hydrogen in a substance is called 'oxidation'. It also involves the loss of electrons.
definitionBean.explanation: In chemical reactions, when oxygen combines with an element or compound or hydrogen is removed from it, it is called an oxidation process.

definitionBean.title: Reduction
definitionBean.definition: Gain of hydrogen or loss (reduction) of oxygen in a substance is called 'reduction'. It involves the gain of electrons.
definitionBean.explanation: The reduction process is completely opposite to oxidation. In this process, either hydrogen is added or oxygen is removed.

questions.text: Quick Revision - Oxidizing and Reducing Agents

definitionBean.title: Oxidizing and Reducing Agents
definitionBean.definition: Substances that oxidize other substances and are themselves reduced are called 'oxidizing agents'; and those that reduce others are called 'reducing agents'.
definitionBean.explanation: In redox reactions, both oxidizing and reducing agents work simultaneously. An oxidizing agent accepts electrons while a reducing agent donates electrons.
importantPoints: Oxidizing Agent: Which provides oxygen or accepts electrons
Reducing Agent: Which provides hydrogen or loses electrons
Redox Reaction: In which both oxidation and reduction take place simultaneously

parts.statement: Define oxidation. Explain with a suitable chemical equation.
parts.correct_answer: Oxidation involves the addition of oxygen or the loss of hydrogen.
parts.explanation: The chemical process in which oxygen is added to a substance or hydrogen is removed from it is called oxidation. Example: When copper powder is heated, a layer of oxygen coats it to form copper oxide: $\text{2Cu} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{2CuO}$.

parts.statement: What is reduction? How is it different from oxidation?
parts.correct_answer: Reduction involves addition of hydrogen or loss of oxygen, which is opposite to oxidation.
parts.explanation: Reduction is the process in which hydrogen is added to a substance or oxygen is removed from it. It is the opposite of oxidation because oxygen is added in oxidation while oxygen is removed in reduction.

parts.statement: Explain the difference between an oxidizing agent and a reducing agent.
parts.correct_answer: An oxidizing agent oxidizes another substance, while a reducing agent reduces another substance.
parts.explanation: A substance that provides oxygen to another substance or oxidizes it in a chemical reaction and is itself reduced is called an 'oxidizing agent'. Conversely, a substance that reduces another substance (provides hydrogen) is called a 'reducing agent'.

parts.statement:
Identify the substances oxidized and reduced in the following equation:
$\text{CuO} + \text{H}_2 \rightarrow \text{Cu} + \text{H}_2\text{O}$
parts.correct_answer: Hydrogen is oxidized and copper oxide is reduced.
parts.explanation: In this reaction, hydrogen ($\text{H}_2$) is oxidized to water ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$), and copper oxide ($\text{CuO}$) is reduced to copper ($\text{Cu}$).
